decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9556. Series context: trend strength 0.971 and seasonal strength 0.6488; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.189); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.806.
